headline: 251 TO 11.
JEFFRIES IS
THE NOMINEE.
hook: House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries for speaker in a closed-door vote. Nobody ran against him.
With at least 257 seats, the 11 no votes can't block him on Jan. 3. The fight is over what he promises.
